title: Fix CI failures: ESLint ban-ts-comment and async test timing
body:
## Summary
Fixed all CI failures and addressed code review feedback:

### Lint Fixes ✅
- **plugin-kanban**: Changed `@ts-ignore` to `@ts-expect-error` in ObjectKanban.tsx (then removed per review)
- **plugin-kanban**: Removed unused `path` import from vitest.config.ts
- **plugin-calendar**: Changed `@ts-ignore` to `@ts-expect-error` in CalendarView.test.tsx
- **components**: Changed three `@ts-ignore` to `@ts-expect-error` in data-table.tsx

### Test Fixes ✅
- **plugin-timeline**: Fixed test "fetches data when objectName is provided" by wrapping assertion in `waitFor()`

### Code Review Feedback ✅
- **plugin-kanban**: Removed unnecessary `@ts-expect-error` directive since `cardTitle` is already defined in `KanbanSchema`

### Verification ✅
- All lint errors fixed - 0 errors (only warnings remain)
- All modified package tests passing (plugin-kanban: 26 tests, plugin-timeline: 4 tests, plugin-calendar: 8 tests)
- Full build successful
